title: Microsoft DEF 14A definitive proxy statement (est.) — the document that carries the 2026 shareholder-proposal slate and confirms the meeting date
source: SEC: Microsoft's 2026 DEF 14A, accession 0001193125-26-427849 (d61756ddef14a.htm), on data.sec.gov's CIK0000789019 submissions feed (HTTP 200, 185,361 bytes, read direct 2026-10-23): filingDate 2026-10-21, acceptanceDateTime 2026-10-22T00:15:40Z = 20:15 ET on 2026-10-21, i.e. AFTER the 16:00 ET close, so the first session that could price it was Thursday 2026-10-22. The companion DEFA14A (0001193125-26-427867) was accepted five minutes later and an ARS filing sits beside them. The document body (HTTP 200, 2,025,043 bytes) names the annual meeting as December 8, 2026, 8:30 a.m. PT, virtual. Promoted from the 2026-09-09 estimate (window 2026-10-19..2026-10-26, point estimate 2026-10-22) on its own stated criterion: the filing appearing as form DEF 14A, on its ACTUAL date, one day before the point estimate. The entry id keeps the estimated date (ids are permanent). Checked 2026-10-23
notes: CLOSED OUT 2026-10-23 — the filing landed 2026-10-21 (20:15 ET, after the close) and promoted this entry to confirmed on its SEC: source; the id keeps the estimated date. See ## Outcome in docs/research/events/msft-def14a-2026-10-22.md. ORIGINAL NOTES, RESEARCHED 2026-09-09 (D-43) — docs/research/events/msft-def14a-2026-10-22.md. THE CALL IS STAND ASIDE AT EVERY HORIZON, and it is a measurement, not a prior. This lane's own n=18 event study (2008-2025, MSFT minus QQQ, Yahoo adjusted closes via scripts/research/market-data.mjs) anchored on THE FIRST SESSION THAT COULD ACTUALLY PRICE THE FILING rather than on the filing date: mean +0.21pp, median -0.15pp, win 7/18, sd 1.11. Drop 2008-09-30 (the TARP-vote crash rebound, +3.84pp, nothing to do with a proxy) and the cell is mean -0.00pp, median -0.15pp, win 6/17, sd 0.67, t=-0.01, full range [-0.81pp, +1.52pp]. THE ANCHOR CORRECTION MATTERS AND IS THIS LANE'S OWN FINDING: measuring the filing DATE instead measures a session in which the document was not yet public 16 times out of 18. THE D->D+5 CELL IS AN EARNINGS WINDOW IN DISGUISE: it looks like +1.07pp mean, but the proxy is filed a median 7.5 days before the FY-Q1 print, so in 6 of 18 years the five-session window CONTAINS the print (contaminated n=6 mean +2.24pp vs clean n=12 mean +0.49pp); drop the print years and 2008 and it is -0.14pp, win 3/11, t=-0.42. NO PLAYBOOK FIRES, and the after-close acceptance time makes that structural rather than incidental: an overnight gap is the only expression route for a 16:16 ET filing, and S4 (overnight-only) is KILLED on MSFT specifically (trade-playbooks.md), with intraday-edges.mjs putting the overnight bar at 34.8% of MSFT's daily volatility on +0.048% mean and a 2.4bps break-even. WHAT THE DOCUMENT ACTUALLY CARRIES, read from the 2025 proxy direct (sec.gov, HTTP 200, 2,430,412 bytes): four management proposals (12 directors, say-on-pay, auditor ratification, stock plan) and six shareholder proposals, ALL of them AI/data/human-rights risk-audit requests filed by advocacy groups. Not one is a financial disclosure. The proxy is where the AI-governance headlines live and where the guidance does not. IT REMAINS THE DATE FALSIFIER for msft-annual-meeting-2026-12-08: a proxy naming any meeting date other than 2026-12-08 breaks that entry's 8-for-8 10-K-vs-proxy record. KIND: 'sector' because KINDS in scripts/event-scan-validation.mjs has no company-governance slot, same as the parent entry.
